skill.name: cloudbase-agent
skill.description: Build and deploy CloudBase Agent SDK services in TypeScript or Python, including AG-UI streaming, framework adapters, server setup, deployment, UI clients, authentication, storage, and observability.
skill.summary: Guide CloudBase Agent SDK projects from adapter choice to deployment.
skill.author: tencentcloudbase

security_audit.summary: Most static hits are documentation examples or markdown syntax, including placeholder secrets, local URLs, dotenv usage, and inline code. Confirmed risks remain in authentication examples, unverified JWT decoding, public interface binds, shell-based deployment steps, and wildcard CORS guidance.

remediation.issue: Authentication examples can continue after missing or invalid credentials.
remediation.suggestion: Reject missing or invalid tokens, remove anonymous fallbacks, and keep development-only examples clearly separated from production code.

remediation.issue: TypeScript examples trust decoded JWT payloads for tenant isolation.
remediation.suggestion: Verify JWT signatures or use CloudBase-authenticated identity before using sub as a storage partition key.

remediation.issue: Agent server examples use wildcard CORS and public interface binds.
remediation.suggestion: Document production origin allowlists, required authentication, and network restrictions for services listening on 0.0.0.0.

remediation.issue: Deployment guides include shell scripts and destructive env rebuild commands.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before running shell scripts, and warn users to run them only from the intended project root.

remediation.issue: Sample secrets and API keys can look deployable.
remediation.suggestion: Use clearly invalid placeholders and require generated JWT secrets with at least 32 characters.

semantic_findings.title: Authentication Fallback Allows Anonymous Requests
semantic_findings.description: The Coze middleware uses a dev-secret fallback and continues requests as user anonymous when the Authorization header is missing or invalid. This can turn a protected agent endpoint into an unauthenticated endpoint if copied into production.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The cited example directly sets a predictable JWT secret fallback and yields after assigning an anonymous user on missing authentication.

semantic_findings.title: Invalid JWT Example Continues Execution
semantic_findings.description: The basic authentication middleware logs InvalidTokenError and then yields to the agent instead of blocking the request. Later secure guidance exists, but this initial example is unsafe if reused.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The code catches InvalidTokenError, prints the error, leaves the blocking exception commented out, and reaches the yield statement.

semantic_findings.title: Unverified JWT Payload Used for Tenant Isolation
semantic_findings.description: TypeScript adapter examples parse the JWT body with atob and use payload.sub for CloudBaseSaver userId. The signature is not verified before using that value for tenant isolation.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Both examples decode the JWT payload client-side and trust sub for storage isolation without a verification step.

semantic_findings.title: Wildcard CORS in Agent Server Examples
semantic_findings.description: TypeScript and Python examples enable broad CORS on agent endpoints, including FastAPI credentialed CORS. Public agent APIs should use explicit origin allowlists in production.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The cited snippets enable wildcard or broadly enabled CORS for agent servers, and one FastAPI example also enables credentials.

content.value_statement: Agent services need consistent server, adapter, deployment, and UI patterns. This skill guides CloudBase Agent SDK projects in TypeScript and Python.
actual_capabilities: Routes users to TypeScript or Python CloudBase Agent SDK guidance.
Explains AG-UI and OpenAI-compatible agent server endpoints.
Guides LangGraph, LangChain, Coze, CrewAI, and custom adapter setup.
Provides CloudBase deployment steps with runtime and dependency checks.
Covers UI client integration for web and WeChat Mini Program clients.
Documents authentication, storage, observability, and middleware patterns.
limitations: Requires a CloudBase project and compatible SDK packages.
Does not replace provider credentials, runtime access, or platform permissions.
Examples need production security review before public deployment.
Python and TypeScript instructions differ and must not be mixed.

use_cases.title: Launch an Agent API
use_cases.description: Create a CloudBase Agent server with AG-UI streaming and deploy it with the recommended runtime.

use_cases.title: Connect an Agent UI
use_cases.description: Build a web or Mini Program client that streams events from CloudBase Agent endpoints.

use_cases.title: Prepare Production Agents
use_cases.description: Add authentication, storage, observability, and deployment checks for a CloudBase agent backend.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Starter Agent
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a minimal TypeScript CloudBase Agent server using the LangGraph adapter. Include required files and local run steps.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Python Server
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a Python CloudBase Agent server with FastAPI and LangGraph. Add environment variable setup and explain each deployment step.

prompt_templates.title: Review Deployment Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my CloudBase Agent project for dependency alignment, runtime version, CORS, authentication, and deployment readiness.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Production Backend
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a multi-agent CloudBase backend with persistent memory, authentication middleware, observability, and a web AG-UI client.

output_examples.input: Create a TypeScript LangGraph agent and deploy it to CloudBase.
output: Adapter selection with required CloudBase packages.
Server setup outline for AG-UI and OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
Deployment checklist using CloudBase Agent runtime requirements.

output_examples.input: Add authentication and observability to a Python agent server.
output: Middleware plan for validated user context.
Environment variable list for model and tracing providers.
Production checks for CORS, secrets, and endpoint exposure.

output_examples.input: Connect a web client to my agent service.
output_examples.output: The skill identifies the AG-UI client path, endpoint shape, streaming behavior, and deployment considerations.

best_practices: Choose the language path first and read only the matching reference files.
Use current CloudBase Agent packages and the documented runtime requirements.
Validate authentication, CORS, secrets, and observability before public deployment.
anti_patterns: Mixing Python and TypeScript deployment instructions in one project.
Deploying sample credentials, wildcard CORS, or development JWT secrets to production.
Calling deployment tools before dependency and runtime checks pass.

faq.question: Does this skill support both TypeScript and Python?
faq.answer: Yes. It routes to separate TypeScript and Python instructions based on the project language.

faq.question: Can it deploy an agent to CloudBase?
faq.answer: It provides deployment guidance for CloudBase Agent services, including runtime and dependency checks.

faq.question: Does it explain AG-UI streaming?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers AG-UI event streaming and OpenAI-compatible endpoints for agent servers.

faq.question: Which adapters are covered?
faq.answer: The docs cover LangGraph, LangChain, Coze, CrewAI, and custom adapter patterns.

faq.question: Is it only for backend work?
faq.answer: No. It also includes web and WeChat Mini Program client integration guidance.

faq.question: What should users review before production?
faq.answer: Users should review authentication, CORS, secrets, public network exposure, storage, and observability settings.
